title: Attestation
description: Records a single local verification decision for a claim.

claim_id.description: The ID of the claim this attestation covers.

statement_digest.description: Content-addressed digest of the claim statement at time of attestation.

dependency_digests.description: Statement digests of all transitive dependencies, in topological order.

evidence.description: Evidence descriptors used during this attestation.

outcome.description: The verification outcome produced by the checker.

assurance.description: The assurance type asserted by the checker.

error_code.description: Machine-readable error code when outcome is 'error'.

start_freshness.description: Freshness snapshot digest at the start of the checker invocation.

end_freshness.description: Freshness snapshot digest at the end of the checker invocation.

self_digest.description: SHA256 digest of this attestation record, excluding this field.

cache_key.description: Cache key used to look up this attestation in the checker cache.

metadata.description: Domain-specific key-value metadata from the checker output.

toolchain.description: Tool version map reported by the checker (e.g. lean_version, mathlib_commit).

replay_mode.description: How the certificate was verified. 'from_scratch': generator re-run and output digest compared (proofctl replay). 'self_consistency': checker ran against already-imported CAS evidence (proofctl check). Absent for attestations written before this field was introduced.

signature.description: Optional Ed25519 signature over the canonical attestation JSON.
